title: Only One Company Can Build This Machine

scenes.text: Only one company on Earth can build this machine.

ASML, in the Netherlands. It fires lasers at tiny droplets of molten tin, fifty thousand times a second, to make light that prints chip features smaller than a virus. Each one costs well over a hundred million dollars and ships in dozens of containers.
Without it, there are no cutting edge AI chips. That's why governments fight over who may buy one.
The future of AI runs through this. Remember...
